{{Quote|TK-421, why aren't you at your post? TK-421, do you copy?|Pol Treidum|<ref name="ANH" />}}
'''Pol Treidum''' was a a [[Gender|male]] [[human]] who served as an [[Imperial officer|officer]] in the [[Galactic Empire]]'s [[Imperial Military|military]]. In [[1 BBY]], he held the [[Military rank|rank]] of [[lieutenant]] and was stationed aboard the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|first Death Star]]. A [[gantry officer]], he helmed the [[Control Room 327|command office]] that overlooked [[Docking Bay 327]] alongside an [[Pol Treidum's aide|aide]]. One [[Standard day|day]], he noticed that two [[stormtrooper]]s were missing from their stations at the landing ramp of the captured [[starship]] ''[[Millennium Falcon]]''.

After an unsuccessful attempt to hail [[TK-421]] via [[comlink]], Treidum saw a stormtrooper coming down the ramp of the ''Falcon'' and waving to the control room window, tapping at the side of his [[helmet]]. Taking this to mean there was a faulty transmitter, the lieutenant asked his aide to take over while he went to check on the problem. But when the door slid open, Treidum was knocked back into the room by the fist of the [[Wookiee]] [[Chewbacca]], who was part of the ''Falcon''{{'s}} crew. Almost at the same time, the lieutenant's aide was [[Blaster|blasted]] by the Wookiee's colleague [[Han Solo]], disguised as a stormtrooper.

==Biography==
===327 problems, and a Wookiee is one===
{{Quote|Take over. We've got a bad transmitter. I'll see what I can do.|Pol Treidum to his aide|<ref name="ANH" />}}
Pol Treidum<ref name="RiseEnglish">{{EncyclopediaCite|The Rise of the Rebellion and the Battle of Yavin}} {{C|English version only}}</ref> was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] who served in the [[Imperial Officer Corps]] of the [[Galactic Empire]].<ref name="ANH" /> In [[1 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas: Updated Edition]]'' dates the [[Rescue of Princess Leia]] to [[1 BBY]].</ref> he held the rank of [[lieutenant]] and served as a [[gantry officer]] on board the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|first Death Star]] [[superweapon]], working in a [[Control Room 327|command office]] that overlooked [[Docking Bay 327]].<ref name="Rise">{{EncyclopediaCite|The Rise of the Rebellion and the Battle of Yavin}}</ref> Shortly after the [[Destruction of Alderaan|destruction]] of the [[planet]] [[Alderaan]], a [[YT-1300 light freighter]] was pulled into the [[Hangar|docking bay]] by [[tractor beam]] after it neared the [[Death Star]] in the [[Alderaan system]].<ref name="ANH" /> [[Captain]] [[Edmos Khurgee]], the [[security officer]] in charge of Docking Bay 327, waited as Treidum carried out the best exterior scan of the vessel he could with the limited equipment available to him.<ref name="RiseEnglish" /> The scan information was cross referenced with registry searches and images of the captured vessel, allowing the Imperials to identify it as the ''[[Millennium Falcon]]'', a [[Starship|vessel]] that had recently fled from Imperial forces on the planet [[Tatooine]].<ref name="Rise" />

Khurgee then had men enter the vessel and search it, after which the [[Dark Lord of the Sith|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]] arrived in the hangar; however, Khurgee reported that the ''Falcon''{{'s}} crew had a abandoned ship and that the vessel was empty. Vader, Khurgee, and the majority of [[stormtrooper]]s in the hangar then left, leaving only<ref name="ANH" /> [[Scanning crew BT-445]]<ref name="BtmF61">{{BuildFalconCite|61|Secrets of Spaceflight}}</ref> to scan the ship's interior and two stormtroopers to guard the [[entry ramp]]: [[TK-421]]<ref name="ANH" /> and [[TK-710]].<ref name="FACPOV">{{StoryCite|story=Of MSE-6 and Men|book=From a Certain Point of View}}</ref> The ship's crew had not in fact abandoned ship, [[Rescue of Princess Leia|subduing]] the [[scanning crew]] and then luring in the two guards<ref name="ANH" /> and knocking them out<ref name="Odyssey">''[[The Odyssey of Star Wars: An Epic Poem]]''</ref> to steal their [[Stormtrooper armor|armor]]. From up in the command office, Treidum noted the stormtroopers' absence, and attempted to reach TK-421 over [[Comlink|comms]]. When there was no response he frowned and moved to the office's<ref name="ANH" /> forward bay<ref name="GraphicNovel">[[Star Wars: A New Hope Graphic Novel Adaptation|''Star Wars: A New Hope'' Graphic Novel Adaptation]]</ref> window, where he witnessed [[Luke Skywalker]], one of the ''Falcon''{{'s}} crew disguised as TK-421, emerge from the vessel.<ref name="ANH" />

Skywalker tapped his [[helmet]], which Treidum took to mean that the stormtrooper's [[transmitter]] was faulty. He reported as such to<ref name="ANH" /> [[Pol Treidum's aide|his aide]],<ref name="Paperback">[[Star Wars: A New Hope (paperback novel)|''Star Wars: A New Hope'' junior novelization]]</ref> another [[Imperial officer]] also in the command office, and told him to take over while the lieutenant went to try and help out with the transmitter. However, upon opening the office door to leave<ref name="ANH" /> and take a [[turbolift]] down to the hangar,<ref name="Paperback" /> Treidum discovered the rest of the ''Falcon''{{'s}} crew including the [[Wookiee]] [[Chewbacca]], who struck the [[officer]], smashing him into several nearby<ref name="ANH" /> barrel-shaped containers<ref name="Paperback" /> and [[Death|killing]] him.<ref name="Death" />

===Laying among the barrels===
{{Quote|Take over. See to him.|TD-787 orders one of his men to see to Treidum's corpse|<ref name="ANH" />}}
Chewbacca's partner, [[Han Solo]], then shot Treidum's [[aide]], giving the ''Falcon''{{'s}} crew control of the office. The crew left the two Imperials' corpses where they had fallen, and after all but the intruders' [[droid]]s had left the office, a [[squad]] of stormtroopers<ref name="ANH" /> commanded by [[Wanten|TD-110]] arrived to search the office and discovered the dead. The trooper [[TD-787]], who was on point,<ref name="Bump">{{StoryCite|story=Bump|book=From a Certain Point of View}}</ref> gave the order for one of his men to see to Treidum, before discovering the droids hiding in the room's utility closet. The droid [[C-3PO]] claimed that those responsible for attacking the office had headed to the [[prison]] level, prompting all the stormtroopers to rush off bar TD-110, who remained to stand guard but let the droids leave.<ref name="ANH" />

==Personality and traits==
Treidum had light skin, [[Color|brown]] [[eye]]s, and brown [[hair]].<ref name="ANH" /> A testy individual,<ref name="Odyssey" /> his career was ultimately ended by the very type of infiltrators he had always feared.<ref name="Rise" />

==Equipment==
Treidum wore a black [[Imperial officer's uniform]] which included a [[Imperial kepi|cap]] with an [[officer's disk]]. His uniform also include a black [[belt]] with another officer's disk and a [[holster]] for his [[blaster pistol]], black [[boot]]s, a [[rank insignia plaque]] with four blue squares, and a [[code cylinder]] on each [[breast]].<ref name="ANH" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Well hello there, what can I do for you tod… Waaaahhh!|Pol Tredium's dialogue in ''LEGO Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga''|<ref name="LEGO">''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga]]''</ref>}}
[[Peter Sumner]] portrayed<ref name="Deadline">{{WebCite|url=http://deadline.com/2016/11/star-wars-actor-peter-sumner-dies-at-72-1201859445|text=Peter Sumner Dies: Australian Actor Best Known For 'Star Wars' Role Was 74|author=Ross A. Lincoln|date=2016-11-23|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/RJvdo}}</ref> Pol Treidum in the [[1977]] [[original trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']].<ref name="ANH" /> In the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], the character's surname was first provided in the [[2017]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: Geektionary: The Galaxy from A - Z]]''.<ref name="Geektionary">''[[Star Wars: Geektionary: The Galaxy from A - Z]]''</ref> The character's forename was then used in the English release of "[[The Rise of the Rebellion and the Battle of Yavin]]," an entry in [[De Agostini]]'s [[Star Wars Encyclopedia (series)|''Star Wars Encyclopedia'']]<ref name="RiseEnglish" /> series that was originally released in Spanish on [[March 9]], [[2021]].<ref name="De Agostini Date">{{DeAgostini|lang=es|url=libros-comics/enciclopedia-star-wars|text=Star Wars Encyclopedia}}</ref> The name originated in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, where it was first used on a card in the [[1996]] ''[[A New Hope Limited]]'' set of cards for the [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]] made by [[Decipher]]<ref name="CCG">{{CCG|set=A New Hope Limited|cardname=Lt. Pol Treidum}}</ref>

''Geektionary'' describes Treidum as seeing both troopers return to their posts,<ref name="Geektionary" /> whereas the film shows him seeing only the disguised Skywalker.<ref name="ANH" /> The [[2018]] ''[[Star Wars: A New Hope Graphic Novel Adaptation]]'' depicts Treidum wearing a gray Imperial officers' uniform rather than black.<ref name="GraphicNovel" /> ''[[The Rise of a Hero]]'', a [[2017]] adaptation of the original trilogy by [[Louise Simonson]], describes the crew of the ''Falcon'' as entering an empty office rather than encountering Treidum.<ref name="Hero">''[[The Rise of a Hero]]''</ref> ''[[A New Hope: The Princess, the Scoundrel, and the Farm Boy]]'', a [[2015]] adaptation of ''A New Hope'' by [[Alexandra Bracken]], describes Skywalker as accompanying the rest of the ''Falcon''{{'s}} crew up to the office immediately rather than tricking Treidum.<ref name="PSFB">''[[A New Hope: The Princess, the Scoundrel, and the Farm Boy]]''</ref> ''[[The Odyssey of Star Wars: An Epic Poem]]'', a [[2021]] adaptation of the original trilogy, calls the unnamed Treidum a captain.<ref name="Odyssey" />

In the [[2022]] non-canon [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga]]'', Tredium and his aide are watching a video of a [[nexu]] playing piano when they hear doorbell for the control room ring. Tredium opens the door and greets Chewbacca, Skywalker and Solo in a friendly manner but is cut off when Chewbacca forces a stormtrooper helmet over the officer's head. The Wookiee then punches Tredium in the face, causing the helmet to spin round on his head as he collapses.<ref name="LEGO" />
